venture.name: Pantry Pal
venture.idea: A web app that tracks what's in your pantry and suggests recipes you can cook with what you already have.

artifacts.title: Brief: Pantry Pal
artifacts.summary: Track pantry items and suggest recipes from what you have.
artifacts.content_md:
## Goals
Help busy home cooks track pantry items and get recipe suggestions using what they already have.
## Users
Busy home cooks who waste food because they forget what they bought.
## Core features
1. Add items with quantity and expiry date
2. Search items
3. Highlight items expiring soon
4. Recipe suggestions
## Non-goals
Grocery delivery, nutrition tracking.

artifacts.title: Spec: Pantry Pal v1
artifacts.summary: 4 acceptance criteria for the first version.
artifacts.content_md:
## Acceptance criteria
- AC-1: Users can add an item with name, quantity and expiry date.
- AC-2: Search filters items by name, case-insensitive.
- AC-3: Items expiring within 3 days are highlighted.
- AC-4: Recipe suggestions list recipes whose ingredients are all in the pantry.

acceptance_criteria.text: Users can add an item with name, quantity and expiry date.

artifacts.title: Market research: pantry & recipe apps
artifacts.summary: Crowded but fragmented market; main competitors Pantry Check, Whisk and Paprika.
artifacts.content_md:
## Competitors
- Pantry Check: $2.99/month, barcode scanning.
- Whisk: free, recipe saving and shopping lists.
- Paprika: $4.99 one-time, recipe manager.
## Demand
An estimated 18% of US households use a recipe app weekly (source: example.org/survey-2025, estimate).
## Risk
Manual data entry is the main reason users abandon pantry apps.

artifacts.title: Synthetic panel results
artifacts.content_md:
Synthetic — simulated personas, not real customers.
24 personas in 4 segments. Average 'would try' score: 3.9 out of 5. Top objection: typing in every item is tedious (9 of 24 personas). Students were most price-sensitive.

artifacts.title: Decision: proceed
artifacts.summary: Proceed with v1 (confidence 0.72); reduce data-entry friction.
artifacts.content_md:
Verdict: proceed (confidence 0.72).
Reasons for: clear pain around food waste; synthetic panel interest 3.9/5.
Reasons against: data entry friction is the top objection.
Condition: v1 must make adding items fast.

artifacts.content_md: Implements AC-2. 42 of 42 tests passed after 2 iterations. Reviewed by Mina (approve), verified by Ben.
